Senior Officer, Climate Finance
Indonesia
INTRODUCTION TO GGGI

The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a treaty-based international, inter-governmental organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies. To learn more please visit about GGGI web page.
Application Deadline: Shown in the bottom of the page. All applications must be submitted by 10:00 PM (KST) on the closing date.
Position Grade: G9
Position Scale: Country Scale
End date of appointment: 31 December 2028
Salary: National
Position Summary

GGGI has been assigned by the Ministry of Finance, Directorate General of Financial Sector Stability and Development, which serves as the NDA Secretariat to implement the core functions of the NDA GCF in Indonesia, as the Delivery Partner for the Green Climate Fund (GCF) – for the implementation of “Accelerating Climate Finance Access and Delivery through Institutional Reforms in Indonesia (CLAP)” (the “Project”), funded by the GCF Readiness and Preparatory Support Program. This project will build on and complement the results obtain from the previous three GCF Readiness grants implemented in 2019-2020 (Readiness I), 2020-2022 (Readiness II), and 2023-2026 (Readiness III) with GGGI’s support.

The Senior Officer will act as the project manager of CLAP project, funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) Readiness and Preparatory Support Program. The position plays a pivotal role in leading and managing all activities of this multiyear project including driving climate investment and policy, through direct engagement with government, private sector actors, and other related stakeholders. S/he will lead the supervision of the project’s operations, implementation, monitoring and evaluation, and provide oversight to the implementation of the project through coordination and communication with related stakeholders and contribute to accelerating climate finance access and delivery through institutional reform in Indonesia, in close collaboration with the Directorate of Multilateral Cooperation and Sustainable Finance under the Directorate General of Financial Sector Stability and Development, Ministry of Finance, which serves as the National Designated Authority (NDA) Secretariat to the GCF. The Senior Officer will be supported by a project team, including officer, senior associate, and project assistant, but will remain responsible for effective project implementation and management.

The Senior Officer will constitute a key senior member of the Investment Unit of GGGI Indonesia and will report to the Investment Lead of GGGI Indonesia. S/he will work with Investment Unit team to support country program delivery with a focus on climate finance and green investment. The position holder will help design commercially viable green growth projects aligned with GCF and NDC priorities, primarily focused on sustainable energy, land and sea, and other related sectors, such as sustainable transportation, waste management, and sustainable infrastructure. In terms of working arrangement, s/he will work three days per week in GGGI’s designated space within the Ministry of Finance (embedded project office), and on other days will work from the GGGI Jakarta office.

The role demands strong project and people management, strategic coordination, stakeholder engagement, and technical credibility in climate finance to ensure timely and effective delivery of project’s objectives in Indonesia. This position is central to fostering country ownership, promoting policy and climate investment, and contributing to Indonesia’s climate related agenda and sustainable development.
Purpose

Lead the execution of Accelerating Climate Finance Access and Delivery through Institutional Reforms in Indonesia (CLAP) project in Indonesia, ensuring that the project is fully operational, well-governed, aligned with donor requirements and expectations, and responsive to government priorities and needs, while ensuring the achievement of all targeted projects results.

Establish and manage the communication among the key stakeholders in Indonesia, including the NDA Secretariat, sectoral/technical ministries, local government, international/national AEs, to strengthen national coordination, drive country ownership, ensure effective project governance and implementation.

Strengthen the capacity of relevant country stakeholders, to effectively access, mobilize, and manage climate finance, particularly through the development of institutional capabilities, technical expertise, systems, and networks required to identify funding opportunities, develop bankable project proposals, and access and implement GCF-funded activities.
Provide technical advice to the Ministry of Finance as the NDA to enhance strategic frameworks in addressing policy gaps and enabling environments for GCF programming climate investment.
Engagement
Project Management and Implementation

Lead and oversee overall project management, ensuring effective implementation and delivery of planned activities and outputs in accordance with the approved project document, work plans, budget, and donor requirements.

Oversee project monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL), including tracking progress against targets and indicators, assessing results, identifying project implementation challenges, and facilitate adaptative management.

Oversee project financial management, including budget planning, expenditure monitoring, financial forecasting, and coordination with relevant finance teams to ensure sound financial management and compliance with internal rules and donor requirements.

Ensure timely preparation and submission of high-quality project reports for both internal GGGI reporting and external donor reporting, covering narrative/technical and financial progress and achievements.

In close coordination with the NDA Secretariat, lead the development, consolidation, and monitoring of annual or periodic work plan, ensuring alignment with project objectives, strategic priorities, available resources, and project timeline.
Provide operational direction and technical guidance to the project implementation team.
Deliver excellence in team and people management, as well as project and output management, using GGGI’s systems and processes and in line with international good practice.
Provide technical advice to the GGGI Indonesia Investment Lead, ensuring that climate finance related program align with GGGI, donor, and Government of Indonesia priorities.
Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement

Facilitate effective communication, coordination, and decision-making process between the Ministry of Finance, as the NDA GCF Indonesia, GCF, and all relevant stakeholders’ cohesion and effective process management.
Serve as GGGI’s primary liaison with the Ministry of Finance, and coordinate communication tasks with the NDA on a day-to-day basis.
Lead engagement with donor, including all clarification and reporting.
Facilitate coordination and formal engagement with public and private sector including financial institutions, to attract and improve private investment for climate change related program.

Facilitate the country stakeholder engagement and partnership with the stakeholders involved and explore new potential stakeholders in accessing climate finance through GCF or other climate finance international sources such as Adaptation Fund (AF), Global Environmental Fund (GEF), etc.
Partnerships and Collaboration

Build and maintain strategic partnerships with the Ministry of Finance as the NDA, sectoral ministries/local governments, private sector/financial institutions, international Accredited Entities (AEs), National Accredited Entities, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with other units and divisions at GGGI globally and in Indonesia, particularly those related to GCF program/projects.

Collaborate closely with GGGI Indonesia’s Investment Unit to support investment mobilization efforts, including identifying opportunities, developing investment pipelines, and facilitating engagement with potential climate investors and financing partners.

Support ongoing business development and resource mobilization efforts related to climate finance, including identifying emerging opportunities, contributing to the development of project concepts and proposals, and providing technical inputs to prospective partnerships and funding initiatives.

Contribute to strengthening GGGI’s climate finance portfolio in Indonesia, by leveraging project experience, evidence, lesson learned, and stakeholder networks to inform the development of future programmes and initiatives.
Delivery
The candidate is expected to deliver the following:
Lead and oversee the implementation of CLAP project, including work planning, budgeting, risk management, and M&E, ensuring timely and quality delivery of all project outputs.
Facilitate close coordination with the NDA Secretariat under the Ministry of Finance and other relevant stakeholders, to ensure effective project governance and alignment with national priorities.
Design and manage key outputs and deliverables under the project, including policy recommendations and accelerating access to climate finance in Indonesia.
Ensure timely submission of all narrative and financial reports for both internal GGGI reporting and external donor reporting, in accordance with respective reporting requirements and deadlines.

Ensure robust M&E system are in place, with strong integration of GESI across all activities. In collaboration with Communications team, ensure the project delivers robust communications materials in line with the Donor Guideline, including impact stories and documentation to showcase results to partners.
Uphold GGGI’s values.
Requirements
Qualifications
An advanced degress (Master’s or equivalent) in climate finance, international finance, environmental policy, or other related disciplines.
Preferably 8 years of experience in country-level work experience, in climate and sustainable finance, or investment of climate projects.
Recognized leadership in past appointments as a successful advisor or specialist in the climate finance area.
Proven track record in project management, including planning, budgeting, reporting and financial management; experience with bilateral/multilateral climate donors is an advantage.
Demonstrated experience working with Indonesian government institutions, ministries, or private sectors/financial institutions.

Experience and knowledge of climate change policy, climate finance landscape of Indonesia, international climate finance sources, climate projects development, green growth, and sustainable development.
In-depth familiarity with GCF processes is highly desirable.
Experience in stakeholder engagement and working with inter-institutional programmes.
Ability to lead and work effectively with people from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds.
Excellent English and Indonesian oral and written communication skills.
Functional
Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with GGGI partner institutions.
Experience in policy formulation, capacity building and multi-stakeholder engagement.
Ability to understand Government policy and strategy formulation and implementation mechanisms at national and sub-national levels within a multi-sectoral and cross-sectoral context in Indonesia.
Excellent organizational and management skills and demonstrated experience in successfully mainstreaming of safeguards, gender, poverty reduction and social inclusion.
Demonstrated understanding of principles of green investment and climate financing.
Ability to manage projects that are supported by international and local consultants.
Ability to work in an organized, systematic manner, with degree of innovations and decision-making abilities.
Ability to write concise and clear reports and meeting minutes and to file them effectively and develop and maintain the GGGI database accordingly.
Ability to perform in demanding atmosphere and self-motivate to produce quality results in timely manner.
Corporate
Understand and actively support GGGI’s mission, vision and values.
Promote an organizational culture of trust, transparency, respect and partnership.
Excels at problem solving, asks questions and seeks support when needed, easily shares information and knowledge with others both internally as externally.
Manage emotions and stress positively, build rapport and resolves conflict easily.
Strong ability to work independently and/or remotely, while maintaining productivity.
Work Conditions
Senior Officer is an G9 grade level in GGGI’s National salary scale. Determination of base salary is subject to candidate's experience, academic background and internal equity.
GGGI provides 15% of base salary towards retirement plan/long-term savings, 27 days of annual leave, and private health insurance that covers dental and vision.

GGGI is committed to providing a work environment that is sufficiently flexible to accommodate diverse life-cycle challenges and assist Staff members to achieve a better balance between work and personal/family commitments, thus ensuring high performance, long-term productivity, and well-being of Staff members.
The chosen candidate is expected to be based in Jakarta, Indonesia, and will report to the Country Investment Lead (also based in Jakarta).
This is a national position and does not include relocation benefits.
Project Introduction

GGGI supports the Government of Indonesia (GoI) under the joint GoI-GGGI Green Indonesia Future Initiative Program (GIFT, “the Program”). The Program aims to demonstrate that green investments can become the norm both for investors and planners, ultimately improving the quality of economic development for more environmental sustainability and social inclusion. Through the Program, GGGI collaborates with the Ministry of Development Planning (BAPPENAS) as program host, the Coordinating Ministry of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Forestry, PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (“PT SMI”) , Indonesia Environment Fund (IEF), and others.

In October 2026, the Readiness Proposal for Indonesia, titled Accelerating Climate Finance Access and Delivery through Institutional Reforms in Indonesia has been approved by the GCF Secretariat. Funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF), this 4-year GCF Multiyear Readiness Program will help to strengthen Indonesia’s institutional capacity, governance framework, and strategic planning to mobilize and manage climate finance effectively. Building on lessons from previous Readiness Phases, current program addresses systemic gaps that hinder Indonesia’s ability to access and deploy climate finance at scale, while aligning with national climate priorities and the GCF 2024-2027 Readiness Strategy. It consists of a range of activities with the objective of achieving three main readiness outcomes which will directly contribute to the GCF Readiness Outcomes under the 2024-2027 strategy:
Outcome 1: Strengthened NDA capacity and strategic frameworks for NDC, NAP, and LTS implementation.
Outcome 2: Development of four high-quality concept notes aligned with NCFS programming targets.
Outcome 3: Enhanced knowledge-sharing and regional collaboration to scale climate finance innovation.

Child protection – GGGI is committed to child protection, irrespective of whether any specific area of work involves direct contact with children. GGGI’s Child Protection Policy is written in accordance with the Convention on the Rights of the Child.
